description: A React component for uploading files via drag-and-drop or click-to-select interface.

methods.name: UploadArea
methods.description: React functional component allowing users to upload files through drag-and-drop or clicking to select.

methods.name: onPickClick
methods.description: Triggers the file input's click event to open file browser.

methods.name: onFileChange
methods.description: Handles file selection from the file input; invokes callback with selected file.

methods.name: onDrop
methods.description: Handles the drop event to process the dropped file.

methods.name: onDragOver
methods.description: Handles drag over event to indicate drag state visually.

methods.name: onDragLeave
methods.description: Handles drag leave event to reset drag state.
